partner_result_applied.scope: exact product bathtub purification plus bounded finite-fragment/rational-endpoint localization for fixed measurable slabs

new_result.statement: For every fixed finite C, the full QFORM small-ball inequality with constant C holds iff it holds on product indicators of bounded rational-endpoint finite unions of measure one, rational symmetric matrices with at least three eigenvalues of absolute value strictly greater than one, and rational test intervals. Any strict failure has such a witness with the same violated C.
new_result.proof_mechanism: bang-bang/finite-fragment reduction; scale A and interval to create spectral slack; rational operator-norm approximation on bounded product support; outward rational interval enlargement; singular-value perturbation preserves three large eigenvalues

dead_routes_preserved: single-interval or centered-uniform extremality is false
law-uniform pointwise quadratic Fourier decay is false
rotation to eigen-coordinates does not preserve independence
unresolved_implication: Prove one dimension-free linear slab bound uniformly over rational finite fragments, rational target matrices with strict three-eigenvalue slack, all signs, rotations, fragment counts and separations.
next_attack: Combine the countable strict-slack reduction with paid definite-pair, nonsingular-triple, and diffuse rank-three/separable-phase branches to isolate a quantitative residual leverage-heavy matrix class.
